references.title: OpenMouse mouse-protocol (SteelSeries product table, hardware notes)

limitations: Detection only: UDB sends nothing to SteelSeries mice.
DPI, polling rate, lighting and buttons cannot be read back on any SteelSeries family OpenMouse covers, so they could never be write-verified.
Each codec family has its own command set; one family’s commands would misprogram another’s mice.
Identified by VID/PID through “Identify another device”; UDB requests no SteelSeries interface.
Generated from OpenMouse mouse-protocol @54c68c69: src/steelseries/devices.ts (third_party/openmouse/steelseries-devices.ts), traced there to rivalcfg and the vendor’s GG specification.
